name: Shecurity AI Workshop
postCreateCommand:
python -m pip install --upgrade pip && pip install -r requirements.txt && chmod +x .githooks/pre-commit && git config core.hooksPath .githooks && touch .env && (grep -q '^OPENROUTER_API_KEY=' .env || printf 'OPENROUTER_API_KEY=put-your-key-here
' >> .env) && (grep -q '^CTFD_URL=' .env || printf 'CTFD_URL=https://shecurity.em0.at
' >> .env) && (grep -q '^CTFD_CATEGORY=' .env || printf 'CTFD_CATEGORY=pentesting-with-ai
' >> .env) && (grep -q '^CTFD_USERNAME=' .env || printf 'CTFD_USERNAME=put-your-ctfd-username-here
' >> .env) && (grep -q '^CTFD_PASSWORD=' .env || printf 'CTFD_PASSWORD=put-your-ctfd-password-here
' >> .env)
